Definition: from G303 and G5316; to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively) to have pointed out:--(should) appear, discover.
BiblicalUsage: The word means to show, to appear: Jesus added a parable because He was near Jerusalem and they thought the kingdom of God should immediately appear — and on the voyage to Jerusalem, when the ship had discovered Cyprus, they left it on the left hand and sailed on. It is the appearing of a kingdom the crowds expected at once, and the appearing of an island on the horizon.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for appearing carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the expectation — the kingdom the crowds thought should appear at once, and the parable Jesus told to correct them.
